holds.why_not_repaired: hg_kseos is not a distribution this package declares, and it cannot be declared without asserting something false. tools/hgk_admission_driver.py:25-26 and tools/knowledge_ready_probe.py:61-63 import it only AFTER sys.path.insert(0, str(args.hgk_root / 'src')), i.e. the module is injected at invocation time from an external HG-KSEOS checkout given by --hgk-root, not resolved from the environment the package installs into. Putting it in [project.dependencies] would claim a PyPI-installable runtime requirement that does not exist; putting it in the test extra would be equally untrue. The gate's model -- every top-level import must appear in a manifest -- is what produces this FAIL. Clearing it honestly needs either owner-sanctioned packaging of hg_kseos or a gate feature for sys.path-injected external toolkits. Neither is F2's call, and F2 will not make the checker quiet to look green.
